extensionDescription.message: Easy access on ArXiv! Auto-rename tabs to paper title, Quick navigation via button/hotkey, Save PDFs by paper title, and more.

currentFilenameFormat.description: Label for the currently configured filename format.

loading.description: Placeholder shown before an option value is loaded.

newFilenameFormat.description: Label for the filename format input.

willOpenInNewTab.description: Label for the current open-in-new-tab value.

update.description: Button label for saving an option.

revertToDefault.description: Button label for restoring default options.

filenameFormatNote.message: Note: Re-open arXiv tabs for new filename and download settings to take effect.
filenameFormatNote.description: Explains when changed filename and download settings take effect.

help.description: Label for links and menu items that open the project help page.

currentFilenameReplacementRules.description: Label for the current filename replacement rules.

newFilenameReplacementRules.description: Label for the filename replacement rules input.

willAskWhereToSavePdf.message: Will ask where to save each PDF
willAskWhereToSavePdf.description: Label for the current save dialog setting.

askWhereToSavePdf.message: Ask where to save each PDF
askWhereToSavePdf.description: Label for the save dialog checkbox.

filenameSafetyNote.message: Note: Built-in filename safety rules are always applied after custom rules.
filenameSafetyNote.description: Explains that built-in filename safety rules apply after custom rules.

yes.description: Affirmative value shown for enabled options.

no.description: Negative value shown for disabled options.

filenameRulesMustBeArray.message: Filename replacement rules must be an array.

filenameRuleMustBeObject.message: Filename replacement rule $NUMBER$ must be an object.

filenameRuleMustHaveStringFields.message: Filename replacement rule $NUMBER$ must have string `from` and `to` fields.
filenameRuleMustHaveStringFields.description: Validation error shown when a filename replacement rule has invalid fields.

filenameRuleFromCannotBeEmpty.message: Filename replacement rule $NUMBER$ `from` cannot be empty.
filenameRuleFromCannotBeEmpty.description: Validation error shown when a filename replacement rule has an empty source value.

invalidFilenameReplacementRules.description: Alert shown when filename replacement rules are invalid.

unableToSaveOptions.description: Alert shown when extension options cannot be saved.
